brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Only one base piece is placed (piece:0,0,0 half-n, North half of a hex base). No other bases, bins, covers or props were added; no caps were added either.

Drawers only sit on the cut face of a half base, and a single base offers exactly one drawer socket (drawer:0#0,0#cut). With one base there is no way to place a second or further drawer, so the build holds one drawer, not five.

finish.summary: I built the closest version the configurator allows: one hex base (North half, piece at q0 r0 level 0) with one drawer on its cut face. The configurator offers only one drawer position per base, so five drawers cannot fit in a single base. Five drawers would need several bases placed beside one another (each with its own cut face), which the brief rules out. check_build is ok with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
